name: The Rag Queen

source.note: A side quest boss of our own (The One-Horned Billy, docs/story/side_quests.md), built from the 2025 Monster Manual's scarecrow (Fearsome Claw, Terrifying Glare, its immunities and fire vulnerability), scaled to a Huge construct of CR 10 with legendary actions.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.summary: Twice a day, a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When the Rag Queen fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead, twice a day.

traits.name: Restitching
traits.summary: Regains 15 HP at the start of her turn unless she took fire damage since her last turn.
traits.text: The Rag Queen regains 15 Hit Points at the start of each of her turns: the field's straw and the brides' thread stitch her back together. If she took Fire damage since the start of her last turn, this trait doesn't work on that turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The Rag Queen makes two Fearsome Claw attacks.

actions.name: Fearsome Claw
actions.summary: A long raking claw of sewn bones that leaves the target Frightened until the end of her next turn.
actions.text: Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) Slashing damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of the Rag Queen's next turn.

actions.name: Terrifying Glare
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6: a creature within 30 ft makes a DC 16 Wis save or is Frightened and Paralyzed until the end of her next turn.
actions.text: One creature the Rag Queen can see within 30 feet makes a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. Failure: the target has the Frightened and Paralyzed conditions until the end of the Rag Queen's next turn.

summary: Baba Lysaga's masterpiece: a scarecrow twice the height of a man, stitched from the wedding dresses of every drowned bride of Berez, with a mouth full of their rings. Her claws frighten, her glare freezes, the field stitches her back together, and only fire stops it.
